purpose: Establish a mandatory Economics Debt Register within the Economics SSOT.

definition.economic_debt: Any unresolved dependency, unvalidated assumption, missing definition, incomplete metric, unsupported claim, missing simulation, missing evidence, or blocked governance requirement.

debt_categories.GOVERNANCE: Missing policies, audits, registries, or validation rules.
debt_categories.DATABASE: Evidence or results not yet inducted into DB.

initial_debt_entries.description: E3 Sigma_D Distinguishability Gate not completed.
E4 Deformation Stability Gate not completed.
E5 Recovery Validity Gate not completed.
Distinction Wealth Index (DWI) not formally defined.
Simulation evidence DB induction framework not yet implemented.

governance_rules.rule_1: No debt item may be removed without explicit closure criteria.
governance_rules.rule_2: Closed debt must retain historical traceability.
governance_rules.rule_3: Validation gates may create debt items automatically.
governance_rules.rule_4: Economics health reports must include debt summaries.
governance_rules.rule_5: Debt count is a tracked departmental metric.
